info.name: TeeTranscribe API
info.description: TeeTranscribe API. Sign in, upload or supply a public audio URL, create a billing quote, poll until ready, then confirm POST /transcribe with quote_id. One credit equals NGN 1. NGN and USD purchases fund the same credit wallet. Use a fresh client_key per distinct request; reuse it only when retrying the same operation. Email/password accounts must verify email before using protected workspace endpoints. Google-verified accounts are verified automatically. Welcome, credit reservation and credit return emails are delivered through the outbox and default Redis queue. Credit purchase invoices retain their existing flow.

request.description: Creates a local unverified account and token. The welcome email contains the verification link. Verify email before accessing dashboard features; /user, logout and verification resend remain available.

Signs in local accounts, including unverified accounts so they can resend verification. User includes emailVerified; fetch /user for email_verified_at. Administrators still require their email two-factor code.
Requires authentication and verified email. Updates only the signed-in account name; email, roles and other accounts cannot be changed through this endpoint.

Requires authentication, verified email, correct current password, and confirmed new password of at least eight characters including letters and numbers. Revokes all login tokens, remembered sessions, reset links and outstanding admin login codes. Log in again afterward. Limited to five requests per account per minute.

Always returns the same response for registered and unknown emails. Sends a queued reset email with a 60-minute, single-use token; repeated delivery is throttled. Separate IP and email rate limits apply.

Use the token from the email link. A successful reset revokes all Sanctum tokens, remembered sessions and outstanding administrator login codes. It does not verify the email. Invalid, expired, or reused tokens return 422.
Requires login, but not a verified email. Sends a signed verification link only when needed. Rate limited to one request per user per minute.

Copy id, hash, expires, and signature from the verification email. No login is required; the expiring signed link proves ownership. Tampered and expired links return 403. Reusing a valid link is harmless.
Requires a Google-verified email identity. New social accounts are welcomed and automatically verified; an existing local account linked through Google is verified without another welcome email.

Available to both verified and unverified signed-in accounts. Returns email_verified_at and authoritative email_verified (true for verified local emails and social-auth accounts). Unverified local accounts must verify before using workspace endpoints.

request.description: Requires authentication and a ready, unexpired owned billing quote. Reserves credits atomically and reuses the same transcription when retried. Set folder_id to an owned folder or null for today’s folder. Optional name (up to 255 characters) sets the transcription title and PDF/TXT download names; omitted or blank uses the source filename.

Requires authentication and a ready, unexpired owned billing quote. Reserves credits atomically and reuses the same transcription when retried. Set folder_id to an owned folder or null for today’s folder. Optional name (up to 255 characters) sets the transcription title and PDF/TXT download names; omitted or blank uses the source filename.

Returns the folder's transcriptions and temporary download links for completed TXT and PDF exports. Deepgram transcripts also include provider, timed segments (start/end seconds, speaker, text, confidence), and audioUrl for playback. R2 playback URLs expire after one hour; reopen the folder to refresh them.

Prepares missing or failed PDF, TXT and DOCX exports for an owned transcript, including speaker-labelled variants when segments contain speaker names. Existing successful exports and transcript content are preserved. Returns 202 with id/status while generating, or 200 if all files are ready. Repeated requests share the queued job; the transcript edit rate limits also apply. Poll GET /folders/{{folderId}} for exports with format, variant (plain or speakers), status and signed downloadUrl.

Updates an owned transcript and queues replacement TXT, PDF and DOCX exports in plain and speaker-labelled variants. For timed Deepgram editing, include segments in their original order, each containing text and nullable speaker. Segment count must match the stored transcript; timing and confidence remain unchanged. The server derives transcript from segment text. Plain-text edits clear timed segments to prevent stale alignment. Unchanged content preserves existing exports and queues no regeneration. Changed saves reset exports to pending; edits within five seconds share a regeneration job for the latest revision. Limits: 10 requests/minute per transcription and 30/minute per user; excess requests return 429 with Retry-After. Revision checks prevent old jobs from publishing or failing newer edits.

Validates metadata.request_id against a Deepgram transcription, atomically stores transcript and results.utterances as timed segments, and moves the transcription to processing while PDF, TXT and DOCX exports are generated. Utterances include start, end, transcript, optional speaker number and confidence. Duplicate callbacks do not overwrite saved edits.

item.name: Resumable R2 uploads
item.description: Start → status (authoritative uploaded parts) → sign each missing part → PUT bytes directly to R2 → complete. Pause means stop sending parts. After interruption select the original file and reuse client_key. Cancel aborts unfinished parts. Never send transcript requests until completion succeeds.

request.description: Signed-in uploads only. Reuse the same client_key and metadata to recover an interrupted start. Up to 5 GiB, 16 MiB parts. This example is one 2048-byte final part; use the exact source-file bytes.

item.name: Upload part bytes directly to R2

request.description: Select the corresponding file chunk, not the entire source file unless it fits in one part. Do not send the API bearer token to R2. After a failed PUT obtain a fresh signed URL for the same part number.
Returns active, configured payment methods supporting the requested currency. Package responses also contain payment_methods.

Returns a measuring quote and immediately queues media inspection after the transaction commits. Completed uploads owned by this user are probed through a fresh signed R2 URL; remote probing falls back to local inspection when necessary. Pasted URLs keep the verified-download flow. Poll the quote until ready before confirming transcription. The outbox recovers dispatch failures.

item.name: Create quote from public audio URL

request.description: Returns a measuring quote and immediately queues media inspection after the transaction commits. Completed uploads owned by this user are probed through a fresh signed R2 URL; remote probing falls back to local inspection when necessary. Pasted URLs keep the verified-download flow. Poll the quote until ready before confirming transcription. The outbox recovers dispatch failures.

Choose a payment_method code from the active payment methods endpoint (paystack or flutterwave). Both gateways may be enabled simultaneously. The chosen method is stored on this purchase and cannot change on an idempotent retry. Amounts are minor currency units.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const result = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("paymentId", result.id); }

request.description: Returns the selected gateway’s verified hosted checkout URL. Paystack uses PAYSTACK_CALLBACK_URL from the backend environment for its callback_url; Flutterwave uses FLUTTERWAVE_CALLBACK_URL for redirect_url. Paystack returns reference and Flutterwave returns tx_ref. The frontend /payment/callback route forwards that reference to /dashboard/billing, which verifies the payment with the backend; query-string status is not proof of payment. Verify the payment through the authenticated verification endpoint before treating it as paid. Flutterwave test-mode purchases also accept its checkout-v2.dev-flutterwave.com checkout host; live purchases only accept checkout.flutterwave.com.
Send the stored payment reference, or the callback reference / tx_ref. Verification uses the gateway saved on the payment and credits the wallet once.

Paystack sends this server-to-server. Signature is HMAC SHA512 of the exact raw request body with PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY. Do not put live secret keys into shared collections. The backend independently verifies amount, currency, reference, customer, and environment.

Flutterwave v3 sends this server-to-server. Configure FLUTTERWAVE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_HASH and the same secret hash in Flutterwave. The backend independently verifies the stored purchase with Flutterwave before crediting the wallet; duplicate events are idempotent.

Payment owner only. Returns url and expires_at for a five-minute R2 PDF download. Returns 409 while invoice generation is pending. Payment history includes invoice_ready and invoice_number. Confirmed payments enqueue a PDF invoice and email with attachment; run the scheduler/outbox publisher and default Redis queue worker.
Global Google NMT catalog. Yoruba, Igbo and Hausa appear first. Pidgin is not offered unless supported by the provider.
Check credits before confirming. Reuse client_key for retries of identical input. Optional transcription_id links an owned transcript; optional segments preserve speaker names and stored timestamps.
Idempotent confirmation reserves credits and queues processing. Poll the returned translation ID.
Paginated history belonging to the authenticated user.
Includes translated text, speaker segments and signed PDF, TXT and DOCX download links when complete.
Regenerates exports without translating or charging again. Include segments with text and speaker to preserve speaker exports. Repeated unchanged saves are ignored; failed exports can be retried.
Global Dubbing v2 languages and dialects. Yoruba and Hausa appear first. Igbo and Pidgin are not listed as supported.

First upload an MP4 or WebM via multipart uploads using video/mp4 or video/webm. Set videoStoragePath to its returned audio_storage_path. Server measures duration before pricing. Poll the quote until ready. Reuse client_key when retrying an identical request.
Wait for ready status and inspect credit_units/enough_credits before confirmation. Duration quantity is in milliseconds.
Idempotent confirmation reserves credits and records an outbox event. The scheduler and dedicated dubbing worker perform processing.
Paginated history belonging to the authenticated user.
Poll pending or processing records. Complete records include signed MP4 preview, MP4 download and FLAC audio download links.
Only retries failed output preparation when provider generation already completed. Reuses the same provider project and charge, without starting another paid dub.
